name: Zhaowei
summary: Shenzhen Zhaowei Machinery & Electronics Co., Ltd., founded in 2001 and headquartered in Shenzhen, researches, designs, makes and sells micro transmission and drive systems in China and abroad. Its products include several types of gear motors, DC motors, planetary gearboxes, encoders, controls, precision parts and molds, serving telecommunications, automotive, robotics, medical, smart home and consumer electronics customers. It also runs venture capital and asset management activities.
